artifacts.summary: Re-measured inventory of raw `git commit -m` call sites across agent-system/extensions/ (103 files/161 occurrences), categorized into 5 legitimate exceptions and 98 real call sites tiered by migration priority (root-cause templates/docs first, then core commands/skills, then core process docs, then ~68 extension files), plus a lint design modeled on lint-state-writer-boundary.sh.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo's agent-system/extensions/ source store, command/skill boilerplate patterns (e.g. git commit invocations) propagate almost entirely by copy-paste from context/templates/command-template.md and docs/templates/command-template.md, plus a small set of core 'how-to' reference docs (git-safety.md, wrap-up.md, checkpoint-commit.md, skill-git-workflow/SKILL.md). When fixing a systemic anti-pattern across many call sites, fix these root templates/docs FIRST -- every extension command/skill/agent sampled (founder, present, lean, web, filetypes, epidemiology, cslib, etc.) reproduced the identical anti-pattern shape, confirming copy-paste lineage rather than independent invention.

lint-state-writer-boundary.sh is the established two-layer design template for new 'detect a hand-rolled anti-pattern across the source store' lints in this repo: (1) a broad candidate regex over .md/.sh files narrowed by a structural line classifier, (2) a short, reason-carrying file-level allowlist (never bare paths) for legitimate exceptions including the lint's own path and its test fixture. New lints of this family (state-writer boundary, scoped-commit boundary, etc.) should be modeled on it and wired into verify-deploy.sh as a new numbered gate plus registered in manifest.json's lint array, using the same [SKIP]-if-not-source-store posture as sibling gates 6/7/9/11/12.
